footprint.note: grows on the flat roof of any building with a 3x3 roof; level 0 is the host roof

requires.note: host must be complete and at least 2 levels tall

placement.spawns: self-builds over time when housing demand exceeds supply and a roof sits unused (not placed by the player)

power.note: tapped from the host, often informally

water.source: rooftop tanks filled from the host riser

light_air.note: adds up to 2 levels of clutter above the host roof

safety.note: fire risk: timber and tin, one stair

economy.note: residents build it themselves; costs are materials only

construction.name: roof patch
construction.action: tar and patch the host roof

construction.name: rooms
construction.action: raise two block add-on rooms along the back parapet

construction.name: shacks
construction.action: nail up four tin shacks in front, two more on the room roofs, the plank walkway and the ladder

construction.name: utilities
construction.action: haul up water tanks, run hoses, raise antennas and dishes

construction.name: life
construction.action: laundry lines, styrofoam gardens, signs, lanterns - the village fills in
